review_notes: I read the whole target file. It introduces no new definitions, structures or abbreviations. It has only lemmas and a final theorem. Some private lemmas (`inverse_map`, `map_determined_inverse`, `norm_block`) are thin wrappers around `ResidualAlgebra` lemms. They only discharge the positivity hypothesis `coefficient_u_pos`, so they are not competing versions of a Mathlib concept. The concepts the file uses (`weightedSum`, `O3.pairing`, `lpNorm`, `conjugateExponent`, `dualP`) are defined in other project files. `conjugateExponent` already delegates to `Real.conjExponent`. `pairing` is a plain sum of products over `Point d`, and `weightedSum` is a coordinatewise finite sum. Whether these duplicate Mathlib's inner product or `lpNorm` machinery is a question about those other files, not this one, so I did not report it. I found no justified finding under this rubric. The one uncertainty is that I did not examine the other files in depth.
